name: TextField
description: A text input with a floating label. Also the trigger for Combobox and DateField.

provenance.tag: Live and File A agree on the floating label; Rec (sizes, states, colours)

props.name: label
props.description: Sits inside the field at rest; moves up to caption (12px) on focus or when filled.

props.name: size
props.description: --control-height-sm/md/lg: 40 / 48 / 56, the same scale as Button. sm has no floating label (the label sits above the field). lg for the hero search. Live fields are 40px, too tight for a floating label, so md is 48px.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: E.g. airplane-takeoff in the From field.

props.name: errorText
props.description: Replaces the helper and sets the error state.

props.name: required
props.description: Sets aria-required. Optional fields are marked "(optional)" in the label instead of marking required ones with *.

props.name: name / type / autoComplete / inputMode
props.description: Passed through. Passenger forms need autoComplete (given-name, family-name, email, tel, bday) to meet WCAG 1.3.5.

props.name: dir
props.description: ltr for email, phone, booking reference and passport number, even on Arabic pages.

states.name: default
states.visual: 1px --color-border-control, label inside the field in body-md --color-text-subtle.

source.tag: Floating label: Live + A · unverified. Border colour: Rec (D4).

states.name: focus
states.visual: 2px --color-border-focus (black), drawn as the 1px border plus a 1px inset shadow so the field does not shift; label moves up to caption.

source.tag: Label: A · unverified. Colour: Rec, replaces File A's red (D20).

states.name: filled
states.visual: 1px border; label stays up in caption; value in body-md --color-text-default.

states.name: error + focus
states.visual: 2px crimson border, plus the black focus ring outside it (--focus-ring-offset).

requirements: <label for> linked to the input. The floating label is a real <label>, never a placeholder.
helperText and errorText are linked with aria-describedby.
Error: aria-invalid="true", the message starts with the error icon, and the text says how to fix it ("Enter the name as shown on the passport").
Form-level errors: on submit, move focus to an error summary at the top that links to each field.
required sets aria-required. autoComplete is set for personal data.
Focus is black and error is crimson; the error state also carries an icon and a message, so it never depends on colour.

rtl: Text inputs follow the page direction (right-aligned in Arabic).
Email, phone, booking reference, passport number and card number inputs are always dir="ltr".
Passenger names must be in Latin characters (passports, airline systems): say so in helper text and validate with a clear error, rather than silently rejecting Arabic input.
Error messages and helper text sit at the start edge.
rules: Background --color-bg-surface; border --border-width-1 --color-border-control; radius --radius-control; padding-inline --space-3; value body-md.
